about: Oxycodone (OxyContin, by brand name only) is supplied eight times over about seven months to a person aged 73, and a fall is recorded on 12 March 2026, inside the past 12 months.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about "Falls in the 12 months before the most recent opioid supply". Tapentadol is supplied six times over about five months to a person aged 69.

The 70-year-old patient received a continuous course of tramadol. On the most recent supply date the patient reported no falls in the preceding 12 months. The recorded fall was in June 2025, outside that period.
